invariants.rationale: The method accesses sortMode.name(), which implies sortMode must not be null prior to method exit.
Only these two enum cases result in the method returning normally; other values throw an exception.
The method returns a new instance for each handled mode, so result must be non-null.
If 'NONE' mode, returns JavaNonSortPartitioner; otherwise, does not.
If 'GLOBAL_SORT' mode, returns JavaGlobalSortPartitioner; otherwise, does not.
